entities.name: Query GlmU-like protein
observations: Sequence length is 461 aa and contains several ambiguous X residues, preventing reliable physicochemical calculations.
Best curated homologs are bacterial bifunctional GlmU proteins with 51.2–52.2% identity, 98.0–98.5% query coverage, and E-values of 1.5e-161 to 2.2e-158.
Likely catalyzes the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis: glucosamine-1-phosphate acetylation and UDP-GlcNAc formation.
Likely binds one Mg2+ per subunit, is cytoplasmic, and forms a homotrimer, based on conserved homolog annotations.
Pfam supports an N-terminal nucleotide-transferase region (NTP_transf_3 and NTP_transferase; residues 7–213) and C-terminal GMPPB_C/hexapeptide-repeat-associated regions.
Functional assignment is moderate homology support rather than direct experimental characterization of this exact sequence.
